description.plain: Long before “performance” became a buzzword, America lived in waffle knits. From soldiers layering up in the field to factory workers and farmers braving dawn shifts, the waffle weave became a staple of American life. Built for warmth, breathability, and hard use. It was simple, honest, and dependable. We took that heritage and reimagined it for today. The Core Waffle Collection brings back the texture that defined generations, built with a modern three-season fabric engineered for comfort and versatility. Our proprietary CORE Waffle knit is a blend of 66% polyester and 34% cotton. It traps just enough heat when you need it and breathes when you don’t. Super soft against the skin, structured enough to hold its shape, this is the hoodie you’ll reach for from the first cool mornings of fall to the thaw of spring. Layer it under a jacket, throw it over a tee, or wear it solo. However you roll, it’s built to keep up. HeiQ Fresh odor-control technology keeps this waffle knit smelling clean longer, neutralizing odor without heavy metals or antimicrobials. Built to stay fresh through hard wear and repeated washes. Thermal Waffle Fabric – Three-season warmth with natural breathability Heritage-Inspired Texture – A nod to the classic American thermal Soft Yet Structured Feel – Double-knit construction resists sag and maintains shape Ribbed Cuffs & Hem – Lock in comfort and hold their fit Minimalist Design – Built for versatility from workdays to weekends
